newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NPC Intl started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NPC Intl started.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it initiated coverage of NPC International Inc with a strong buy rating and set a 12-month price target of $16 on the stock.
-- said NPC, the larget Pizza Hut franchisee, should benefit from new Pizza Hut management and Pizza Hut's future spin-off from PepsiCo
-- said NPC's recent purchase of 126 additional Pizza Hut restaurants from PepsiCo should bolster profits in fiscal 1998.
-- at least 15 to 20 percent annual earnings per share growth is projected over the next three years, with a 29 percent increase estimated for fiscal 1998.
-- expects strengthening same-store sales for Pizza Hit to begin in the June quarter and to be sustained throughout fiscal 1998, which should also result in store operating profit margin expansion.
